summary: Wetour Robotics Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 26, 2026, reporting that the Board of Directors accepted the resignation of Chief Marketing Officer Yu-Tien Chiu, effective immediately, for personal reasons on June 25, 2026. No financial terms, advisors, or additional structural details are disclosed. The departure is an abrupt officer change, not routine. This filing, as a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, is incorporated by reference into the company’s S-8 and F-3 registration statements. Watch for any further management transitions or strategic shifts that may follow this sudden resignation.
